meta.title: Garden Explorers
meta.description: Just as they think mate is assured, an unexpected game of mahjong appears out of nowhere.

units.rawText: Festival shopping street, in a mahjong house.
units.displayText: Festival shopping street, in a mahjong house.

spans.text: Festival shopping street, in a mahjong house.

units.rawText: Amidst the clattering of shuffling tiles, Aki slumps downward in his chair, the spirit leaving his eyes.
units.displayText: Amidst the clattering of shuffling tiles, Aki slumps downward in his chair, the spirit leaving his eyes.

spans.text: Amidst the clattering of shuffling tiles, Aki slumps downward in his chair, the spirit leaving his eyes.

units.rawText: You can't fall now, Aki! We're so close to beating her, victory is in our grasp!
units.displayText: You can't fall now, Aki! We're so close to beating her, victory is in our grasp!

spans.text: You can't fall now, Aki! We're so close to beating her, victory is in our grasp!

units.rawText: One game! If we get one good game, we'll have the clues about the intruders in our hands!
units.displayText: One game! If we get one good game, we'll have the clues about the intruders in our hands!

spans.text: One game! If we get one good game, we'll have the clues about the intruders in our hands!

units.rawText: You're not lying to us, are you? If we win once, you'll tell us everything you know?
units.displayText: You're not lying to us, are you? If we win once, you'll tell us everything you know?

spans.text: You're not lying to us, are you? If we win once, you'll tell us everything you know?

units.rawText: Of course, do you think I would lie? I'm telling you, these intruders have disguised themselves as staff and have been resting here for quite some time.
units.displayText: Of course, do you think I would lie? I'm telling you, these intruders have disguised themselves as staff and have been resting here for quite some time.

spans.text: Of course, do you think I would lie? I'm telling you, these intruders have disguised themselves as staff and have been resting here for quite some time.

units.rawText: What their plans are, and where they plan to go next. I can tell you all of that.
units.displayText: What their plans are, and where they plan to go next. I can tell you all of that.

spans.text: What their plans are, and where they plan to go next. I can tell you all of that.

units.rawText: If you can take one, just one game off me, don't even mention the clues about the intruders. I'll tell you every little secret I have about this whole business~
units.displayText: If you can take one, just one game off me, don't even mention the clues about the intruders. I'll tell you every little secret I have about this whole business~

spans.text: If you can take one, just one game off me, don't even mention the clues about the intruders. I'll tell you every little secret I have about this whole business~

units.rawText: ...Jiangyu, help me up!
units.displayText: ...Jiangyu, help me up!

spans.text: ...Jiangyu, help me up!

units.rawText: See, that's the spirit! Though I should mention that this game is mine. I've got something of a pure number suit.
units.displayText: See, that's the spirit! Though I should mention that this game is mine. I've got something of a pure number suit.

spans.text: See, that's the spirit! Though I should mention that this game is mine. I've got something of a pure number suit.

units.rawText: You...
units.displayText: You...

spans.text: You...

units.rawText: Ooh, self-draw, all pairs!
units.displayText: Ooh, self-draw, all pairs!

spans.text: Ooh, self-draw, all pairs!

units.rawText: A fully concealed hand, and all triplets, thank you very much.
units.displayText: A fully concealed hand, and all triplets, thank you very much.

spans.text: A fully concealed hand, and all triplets, thank you very much.

units.rawText: Self draw, two flower tiles, lacking one suit. Two triplets on the same number, all even-numbered triplets, and four concealed triplets, making this the 94th recorded instance of this combination across internationally recorded standard mahjong. Woohoo!
units.displayText: Self draw, two flower tiles, lacking one suit. Two triplets on the same number, all even-numbered triplets, and four concealed triplets, making this the 94th recorded instance of this combination across internationally recorded standard mahjong. Woohoo!

spans.text: Self draw, two flower tiles, lacking one suit. Two triplets on the same number, all even-numbered triplets, and four concealed triplets, making this the 94th recorded instance of this combination across internationally recorded standard mahjong. Woohoo!

units.rawText: <size=100>Gah—</size>
units.displayText: Gah—

spans.text: Gah—

units.rawText: Aki! Aki! What's going on? You can't just fall like this, Aki! You're the only one here who knows how to play mahjong!
units.displayText: Aki! Aki! What's going on? You can't just fall like this, Aki! You're the only one here who knows how to play mahjong!

spans.text: Aki! Aki! What's going on? You can't just fall like this, Aki! You're the only one here who knows how to play mahjong!

units.rawText: What a shame that is. You haven't won a single game!
units.displayText: What a shame that is. You haven't won a single game!

spans.text: What a shame that is. You haven't won a single game!

units.rawText: I can still... I've got another chance!
units.displayText: I can still... I've got another chance!

spans.text: I can still... I've got another chance!

units.rawText: Tsk tsk, listen to what you're saying, Aki.
units.displayText: Tsk tsk, listen to what you're saying, Aki.

spans.text: Tsk tsk, listen to what you're saying, Aki.

units.rawText: You've lost your bet along with all of your clothes already! If we go by the record, you're only meant to have your undergarments and leggings remaining.
units.displayText: You've lost your bet along with all of your clothes already! If we go by the record, you're only meant to have your undergarments and leggings remaining.

spans.text: You've lost your bet along with all of your clothes already! If we go by the record, you're only meant to have your undergarments and leggings remaining.

units.rawText: No getting away from the consequences~ come on, strip!
units.displayText: No getting away from the consequences~ come on, strip!

spans.text: No getting away from the consequences~ come on, strip!

units.rawText: One more game! I won't lose. Even if I do, I'll abide by the rules!
units.displayText: One more game! I won't lose. Even if I do, I'll abide by the rules!

spans.text: One more game! I won't lose. Even if I do, I'll abide by the rules!

units.rawText: An optimistic one, aren't you? Well, let's play, then.
units.displayText: An optimistic one, aren't you? Well, let's play, then.

spans.text: An optimistic one, aren't you? Well, let's play, then.

units.rawText: Let's see if you are as lucky as you are confident. If you lose again, though, I'm sure you know what's going to follow~
units.displayText: Let's see if you are as lucky as you are confident. If you lose again, though, I'm sure you know what's going to follow~

spans.text: Let's see if you are as lucky as you are confident. If you lose again, though, I'm sure you know what's going to follow~

units.rawText: No matter, I'll win this game!
units.displayText: No matter, I'll win this game!

spans.text: No matter, I'll win this game!

units.rawText: That's the type of expression I like to see. Come on, then.
units.displayText: That's the type of expression I like to see. Come on, then.

spans.text: That's the type of expression I like to see. Come on, then.

units.rawText: Twenty minutes later...
units.displayText: Twenty minutes later...

spans.text: Twenty minutes later...

units.rawText: Jiangyu, stop staring at the table, will you? Even if you gaze a hole through the table, it won't change a thing about how the game turned out~ You'd be better off helping me figure out where these clothes will go.
units.displayText: Jiangyu, stop staring at the table, will you? Even if you gaze a hole through the table, it won't change a thing about how the game turned out~ You'd be better off helping me figure out where these clothes will go.

spans.text: Jiangyu, stop staring at the table, will you? Even if you gaze a hole through the table, it won't change a thing about how the game turned out~ You'd be better off helping me figure out where these clothes will go.

units.rawText: If Aki has a lack of fans at the Oasis, I think I'll have no choice but to toss them in the bin.
units.displayText: If Aki has a lack of fans at the Oasis, I think I'll have no choice but to toss them in the bin.

spans.text: If Aki has a lack of fans at the Oasis, I think I'll have no choice but to toss them in the bin.

units.rawText: Damn you...
units.displayText: Damn you...

spans.text: Damn you...

units.rawText: Don't look at me like that. You have a spare training garb, do you not? The game can continue if you'd like, thanks to that~
units.displayText: Don't look at me like that. You have a spare training garb, do you not? The game can continue if you'd like, thanks to that~

spans.text: Don't look at me like that. You have a spare training garb, do you not? The game can continue if you'd like, thanks to that~

units.rawText: Hey, hey, there's no need to be so rash. Please don't ball your hands up like that.
units.displayText: Hey, hey, there's no need to be so rash. Please don't ball your hands up like that.

spans.text: Hey, hey, there's no need to be so rash. Please don't ball your hands up like that.

units.rawText: If you intend to disobey the rules, I will spare you no quarter.
units.displayText: If you intend to disobey the rules, I will spare you no quarter.

spans.text: If you intend to disobey the rules, I will spare you no quarter.

units.rawText: With a shake of the wrist, a syringe appears in Florence's hand, as if a show of strength.
units.displayText: With a shake of the wrist, a syringe appears in Florence's hand, as if a show of strength.

spans.text: With a shake of the wrist, a syringe appears in Florence's hand, as if a show of strength.

units.rawText: You... are you flaunting something? If your fingers are that dexterous...
units.displayText: You... are you flaunting something? If your fingers are that dexterous...

spans.text: You... are you flaunting something? If your fingers are that dexterous...

units.rawText: You must've cheated! That's got to be it!
units.displayText: You must've cheated! That's got to be it!

spans.text: You must've cheated! That's got to be it!

units.rawText: My sleeves have been folded inward all this time, and I've been manipulating the tiles with only two fingers. I've not cheated you one bit.
units.displayText: My sleeves have been folded inward all this time, and I've been manipulating the tiles with only two fingers. I've not cheated you one bit.

spans.text: My sleeves have been folded inward all this time, and I've been manipulating the tiles with only two fingers. I've not cheated you one bit.

units.rawText: A rather poor look if you have no proof, little girl. It is improper to not accept the results of fair competition, you know~
units.displayText: A rather poor look if you have no proof, little girl. It is improper to not accept the results of fair competition, you know~

spans.text: A rather poor look if you have no proof, little girl. It is improper to not accept the results of fair competition, you know~

units.rawText: Florence is right. Don't worry, Jiangyu. We can still win.
units.displayText: Florence is right. Don't worry, Jiangyu. We can still win.

spans.text: Florence is right. Don't worry, Jiangyu. We can still win.

units.rawText: A change of clothes has restored your morale, hmm? Let us see how many rounds you will survive this time.
units.displayText: A change of clothes has restored your morale, hmm? Let us see how many rounds you will survive this time.

spans.text: A change of clothes has restored your morale, hmm? Let us see how many rounds you will survive this time.

units.rawText: I've seen through your technique!
units.displayText: I've seen through your technique!

spans.text: I've seen through your technique!

units.rawText: Next game, I'll be paying close attention to your fingers!
units.displayText: Next game, I'll be paying close attention to your fingers!

spans.text: Next game, I'll be paying close attention to your fingers!

units.rawText: Hum~ it's embarrassing for a girl when you look at her with such passion in your eyes, you know~
units.displayText: Hum~ it's embarrassing for a girl when you look at her with such passion in your eyes, you know~

spans.text: Hum~ it's embarrassing for a girl when you look at her with such passion in your eyes, you know~

units.rawText: You think that your subtle words will have any effect on me?
units.displayText: You think that your subtle words will have any effect on me?

spans.text: You think that your subtle words will have any effect on me?

units.rawText: Jiangyu, shuffle for us!
units.displayText: Jiangyu, shuffle for us!

spans.text: Jiangyu, shuffle for us!

units.rawText: Aki makes a sweeping gesture, seating himself once more. The response he received, however, would be—
units.displayText: Aki makes a sweeping gesture, seating himself once more. The response he received, however, would be—

spans.text: Aki makes a sweeping gesture, seating himself once more. The response he received, however, would be—

units.rawText: <size=40>Open up!</size>
units.displayText: Open up!

spans.text: Open up!

units.rawText: <size=40>YOUR PIZZA'S HERE!</size>
units.displayText: YOUR PIZZA'S HERE!

spans.text: YOUR PIZZA'S HERE!

units.rawText: CLANG—
units.displayText: CLANG—

spans.text: CLANG—

units.rawText: Hands up! I knew you were here, Florence!
units.displayText: Hands up! I knew you were here, Florence!

spans.text: Hands up! I knew you were here, Florence!

units.rawText: Well well, if it isn't Croque and Sakuya. In new projections, too, how adorable~
units.displayText: Well well, if it isn't Croque and Sakuya. In new projections, too, how adorable~

spans.text: Well well, if it isn't Croque and Sakuya. In new projections, too, how adorable~

units.rawText: Not in the least thanks to you and your concoctions!
units.displayText: Not in the least thanks to you and your concoctions!

spans.text: Not in the least thanks to you and your concoctions!

units.rawText: If it wasn't for you, I'd never in a million years wear this Lunar Metal Rabbit Mina cosplay out in public!
units.displayText: If it wasn't for you, I'd never in a million years wear this Lunar Metal Rabbit Mina cosplay out in public!

spans.text: If it wasn't for you, I'd never in a million years wear this Lunar Metal Rabbit Mina cosplay out in public!

units.rawText: Hehe, no need to thank me.
units.displayText: Hehe, no need to thank me.

spans.text: Hehe, no need to thank me.

units.rawText: Croque and Sakuya? What are you two doing here? Don't jump to conclusions.
units.displayText: Croque and Sakuya? What are you two doing here? Don't jump to conclusions.

spans.text: Croque and Sakuya? What are you two doing here? Don't jump to conclusions.

units.rawText: Aki's going to win this mahjong game here. If we can beat Florence, we'll have all the intel on the intruders we could need.
units.displayText: Aki's going to win this mahjong game here. If we can beat Florence, we'll have all the intel on the intruders we could need.

spans.text: Aki's going to win this mahjong game here. If we can beat Florence, we'll have all the intel on the intruders we could need.

units.rawText: She's tricked both of you. She IS the intruder here!
units.displayText: She's tricked both of you. She IS the intruder here!

spans.text: She's tricked both of you. She IS the intruder here!

units.rawText: If it wasn't for your message, we wouldn't have found her... time to settle the score!
units.displayText: If it wasn't for your message, we wouldn't have found her... time to settle the score!

spans.text: If it wasn't for your message, we wouldn't have found her... time to settle the score!

units.rawText: What?! Florence, you!
units.displayText: What?! Florence, you!

spans.text: What?! Florence, you!

units.rawText: Ehe!
units.displayText: Ehe!

spans.text: Ehe!

units.rawText: Florence winks at the four people in front of her. With a thrust of the knee, the table flips into the air, mahjong tiles scattering.
units.displayText: Florence winks at the four people in front of her. With a thrust of the knee, the table flips into the air, mahjong tiles scattering.

spans.text: Florence winks at the four people in front of her. With a thrust of the knee, the table flips into the air, mahjong tiles scattering.

units.rawText: My thanks to you two for entertaining me, but my shift here is done!
units.displayText: My thanks to you two for entertaining me, but my shift here is done!

spans.text: My thanks to you two for entertaining me, but my shift here is done!

units.rawText: Pomf—
units.displayText: Pomf—

spans.text: Pomf—

units.rawText: As she speaks, Florence tosses forth a handful of powder.
units.displayText: As she speaks, Florence tosses forth a handful of powder.

spans.text: As she speaks, Florence tosses forth a handful of powder.

units.rawText: I'll be taking my leave, then... eh?
units.displayText: I'll be taking my leave, then... eh?

spans.text: I'll be taking my leave, then... eh?

units.rawText: The miasma soon dissipates to reveal a great leaf shielding the group.
units.displayText: The miasma soon dissipates to reveal a great leaf shielding the group.

spans.text: The miasma soon dissipates to reveal a great leaf shielding the group.

units.rawText: The same trick isn't going to work twice!
units.displayText: The same trick isn't going to work twice!

spans.text: The same trick isn't going to work twice!

units.rawText: Give it up! Aegis, weapon at the ready!
units.displayText: Give it up! Aegis, weapon at the ready!

spans.text: Give it up! Aegis, weapon at the ready!

units.rawText: What a pain.
units.displayText: What a pain.

spans.text: What a pain.

units.rawText: You were playing us for fools all this time? Deplorable!
units.displayText: You were playing us for fools all this time? Deplorable!

spans.text: You were playing us for fools all this time? Deplorable!

units.rawText: Aki, why're you so quiet? Are you not angry?!
units.displayText: Aki, why're you so quiet? Are you not angry?!

spans.text: Aki, why're you so quiet? Are you not angry?!

units.rawText: I'm cleaning my blade. Be patient.
units.displayText: I'm cleaning my blade. Be patient.

spans.text: I'm cleaning my blade. Be patient.

units.rawText: Come, now, why so serious... but I'll see you next time!
units.displayText: Come, now, why so serious... but I'll see you next time!

spans.text: Come, now, why so serious... but I'll see you next time!

units.rawText: Florence suddenly waves her arm again. The party instinctively shelters behind the leaf, but the shower of powder never comes.
units.displayText: Florence suddenly waves her arm again. The party instinctively shelters behind the leaf, but the shower of powder never comes.

spans.text: Florence suddenly waves her arm again. The party instinctively shelters behind the leaf, but the shower of powder never comes.

units.rawText: Crap, she tricked us! After her!
units.displayText: Crap, she tricked us! After her!

spans.text: Crap, she tricked us! After her!

units.rawText: The shopping street.
units.displayText: The shopping street.

spans.text: The shopping street.

units.rawText: Beeeeeeep—
units.displayText: Beeeeeeep—

spans.text: Beeeeeeep—

units.rawText: Answer, Kuro, come on!
units.displayText: Answer, Kuro, come on!

spans.text: Answer, Kuro, come on!

units.rawText: Beep—
units.displayText: Beep—

spans.text: Beep—

units.rawText: What is it, Florence? Are you done on your end?
units.displayText: What is it, Florence? Are you done on your end?

spans.text: What is it, Florence? Are you done on your end?

units.rawText: Help me out...
units.displayText: Help me out...

spans.text: Help me out...

units.rawText: Eh?
units.displayText: Eh?

spans.text: Eh?

units.rawText: The situation has developed... beyond my control...
units.displayText: The situation has developed... beyond my control...

spans.text: The situation has developed... beyond my control...

units.rawText: ...So what exactly did you do?
units.displayText: ...So what exactly did you do?

spans.text: ...So what exactly did you do?

units.rawText: Nothing much, just a few rounds of mahjong with Aki and Jiangyu.
units.displayText: Nothing much, just a few rounds of mahjong with Aki and Jiangyu.

spans.text: Nothing much, just a few rounds of mahjong with Aki and Jiangyu.

units.rawText: You—you really do like to play with fire. Bold strategy, I've gotta say.
units.displayText: You—you really do like to play with fire. Bold strategy, I've gotta say.

spans.text: You—you really do like to play with fire. Bold strategy, I've gotta say.

units.rawText: Let's leave that for later, I need some help!
units.displayText: Let's leave that for later, I need some help!

spans.text: Let's leave that for later, I need some help!

units.rawText: You... tell me where you are. I don't want to get drawn into all of that.
units.displayText: You... tell me where you are. I don't want to get drawn into all of that.

spans.text: You... tell me where you are. I don't want to get drawn into all of that.

units.rawText: Kuro, you see, if I am caught, you will not fare much better.
units.displayText: Kuro, you see, if I am caught, you will not fare much better.

spans.text: Kuro, you see, if I am caught, you will not fare much better.

units.rawText: You!
units.displayText: You!

spans.text: You!

units.rawText: She went that way!
units.displayText: She went that way!

spans.text: She went that way!

units.rawText: Come on!
units.displayText: Come on!

spans.text: Come on!

units.rawText: There's no time! I've sent you my co-ords!
units.displayText: There's no time! I've sent you my co-ords!

spans.text: There's no time! I've sent you my co-ords!

units.rawText: Damn it all! You better pay me back for these drones, you hear?
units.displayText: Damn it all! You better pay me back for these drones, you hear?

spans.text: Damn it all! You better pay me back for these drones, you hear?

units.rawText: CLANG!
units.displayText: CLANG!

spans.text: CLANG!

units.rawText: The sound of a heavy object landing fills the air, and Croque makes her appearance behind Florence.
units.displayText: The sound of a heavy object landing fills the air, and Croque makes her appearance behind Florence.

spans.text: The sound of a heavy object landing fills the air, and Croque makes her appearance behind Florence.

units.rawText: Your journey ends here, Florence! Nowhere to run, nowhere to hide!
units.displayText: Your journey ends here, Florence! Nowhere to run, nowhere to hide!

spans.text: Your journey ends here, Florence! Nowhere to run, nowhere to hide!

units.rawText: Don't you think you might be speaking too soon?
units.displayText: Don't you think you might be speaking too soon?

spans.text: Don't you think you might be speaking too soon?

units.rawText: Your mixtures and syringes are useless against Aegis. Give up!
units.displayText: Your mixtures and syringes are useless against Aegis. Give up!

spans.text: Your mixtures and syringes are useless against Aegis. Give up!

units.rawText: Hehe, when did I say that those are all I have at my disposal?
units.displayText: Hehe, when did I say that those are all I have at my disposal?

spans.text: Hehe, when did I say that those are all I have at my disposal?

units.rawText: Vrrrrmmmm—a mechanical vibration comes from above.
units.displayText: Vrrrrmmmm—a mechanical vibration comes from above.

spans.text: Vrrrrmmmm—a mechanical vibration comes from above.

units.rawText: That sound again... careful, Croque!
units.displayText: That sound again... careful, Croque!

spans.text: That sound again... careful, Croque!

units.rawText: Crap!
units.displayText: Crap!

spans.text: Crap!

units.rawText: The drone rams into Croque's shield in a suicide attack, and sparks scatter into the air.
units.displayText: The drone rams into Croque's shield in a suicide attack, and sparks scatter into the air.

spans.text: The drone rams into Croque's shield in a suicide attack, and sparks scatter into the air.

units.rawText: Cough cough...
units.displayText: Cough cough...

spans.text: Cough cough...

units.rawText: Damn, she got away again.
units.displayText: Damn, she got away again.

spans.text: Damn, she got away again.

units.rawText: Croque, are you alright?!
units.displayText: Croque, are you alright?!

spans.text: Croque, are you alright?!

units.rawText: I'm fine, but I didn't see that coming. Never thought that Florence would have an accomplice.
units.displayText: I'm fine, but I didn't see that coming. Never thought that Florence would have an accomplice.

spans.text: I'm fine, but I didn't see that coming. Never thought that Florence would have an accomplice.

units.rawText: To think of it, that drone we shot down before wasn't a creation of Florence's either, in all likelihood.
units.displayText: To think of it, that drone we shot down before wasn't a creation of Florence's either, in all likelihood.

spans.text: To think of it, that drone we shot down before wasn't a creation of Florence's either, in all likelihood.

units.rawText: It's a shame that both of them are too heavily damaged for us to discern an origin...
units.displayText: It's a shame that both of them are too heavily damaged for us to discern an origin...

spans.text: It's a shame that both of them are too heavily damaged for us to discern an origin...

units.rawText: I think we'd better think carefully about our next step.
units.displayText: I think we'd better think carefully about our next step.

spans.text: I think we'd better think carefully about our next step.
